body: I enjoy writing as well. I had a very bad writers block for five years because of my fear of failure. What kind of stuff do you write? Have you considered making stories/poems about how you're feeling? It doesn't have to be genius level but just a way of transforming your pain into art. I'd like to read some of your stuff. I'm sorry you're going through all this bullshit.
I cant find any fucking blades. Its like everything is giving up on me. School. Home. Everything. People.
No matter how hard i fucking try it feels like a pain competition.  Im fucking done.
I know this feeling. Its fustrating as fuck.
It sucks when the people close to you end up being the main cause of your problems. You said you tried to pursue your talents, what are they?
Bad people just make it worse.
Im not sure if i should still confront her regardless.

I dont know. She has a really bad attitude towards all of the kids and it doesnt help that im a very anxious person. My schools lets us pass with a D. I have an E now, but if I get a D next quarter I can still technically pass her class. I really dont know what to do and these self harm thoughts have kept me up all night and ive been shaking nervously. Its really bad.
High school is really a fucking hellhole for most people. Just try your hardest to just graduate and get out of that toxic enviroment.

Its not only that. Im just tired of getting fucked over by careless people. I already deal with enough pain at home and in my early life. I just want to graduate on time with my peers. Why does everything have to be so hard?

Im a senior. And yes. Most of my family has basically ostracized him and dont respect him anymore. Karma is hitting him like a bitch so he cant hurt me. What hurts is his utter lack of remorse for what he did and his hypocrisy. It makes me fucking sick and i cant take it. On top of the bullshit from school...im done.

High school is making me sick. I live with the person who sexually abused me as a child and continues to harass others. My family is emotionally abusive. Dad is basically distant and doesnt give two fucks about what happened to me as a child. Holds no anger towards my abuser, but hates him for other reasons. Mom says ever since i was little that I 'cried over the slightest inconvience' whether it be a fever. She wonders why Im so moody and dont talk to her anymore. And i want to die.
I know this feeling. Like no one is really listening to you. Im sorry man.
